basics.name: Miguel Madrid-Mencía
basics.label: Backend & Cloud Engineer · Genomics & Applied ML
basics.summary: 10+ years across research, genomics, and cloud engineering. 1 first-author and 6 co-authored peer-reviewed publications with 135+ citations. Contributed to a pending patent in applied bioinformatics and genomic data processing.

work.summary: Applied ML Systems. US cloud and AI consultancy. Acquired from Qarik Group in Jan 2025 — role and scope were continuous across the acquisition.
highlights: Built a multi-agent AI orchestration system on GCP for a pharma R&D client, applying genomics domain knowledge to shape agent design.
Developed GCP Agents and A2A orchestration via MCP/ADK.
Built a Twilio-based testing framework to automatically generate all mood and user behaviour call combinations for a Voice AI system, replacing manual script configuration.
Hardened CI/CD pipelines, code quality gates, and security standards for a US financial client — reducing production incidents.

work.summary: GCP-focused cloud consultancy. Acquired by Egen.ai in Jan 2025; role and projects were continuous across the acquisition.
highlights: Delivered an API for data ingestion into BigQuery, deployed on GCP with Terraform and Concourse, for a US biotech client.

work.summary: Cloud genomics platform (Illumina Connected Analytics) and personalized medicine.
highlights: Benchmarked privacy-preserving data-sharing approaches (homomorphic encryption vs. synthetic data) for the Illumina Connected Analytics platform.
Built ML pipelines for genomics and GWAS on the Illumina Connected Analytics platform.

Contributed to a [pending patent](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20240120024A1/) in applied bioinformatics and genomic data processing — built the Hail/Python variant data-processing layer behind the ML model.

work.summary: Translational cancer research center (INSERM). Network biology, epigenomics, and cancer multi-omics.
highlights: Built reproducible Snakemake ML pipelines processing multi-omics datasets (RNA-seq, DNA methylation, 3D chromatin) across multiple cancer cohorts.
1 first-author and 6 co-authored peer-reviewed publications with 135+ citations in oncology and systems biology.
Built [GARDEN-NET](https://pancaldi.bsc.es/garden-net/), a web tool for 3D chromatin interaction analysis — published in Nucleic Acids Research.

work.summary: European HPC center hosting MareNostrum. Life Sciences department.
highlights: Developed a geospatial visualization platform for AQuAS to analyse health outcomes and quality indicators across Catalonia.
Built the OpenEBench embeddable benchmarking widget (sole author) — a d3.js radial arc widget used by scientific tools across the ELIXIR European benchmarking platform.
Primary contributor (79 of 110 commits) to the OpenEBench submission infrastructure — Docker sample containers, Nextflow pipeline generator, Vagrant multi-service VM, and SFTP submission service.

work.summary: Spain's national cancer research institute. Structural biology and molecular oncology.
highlights: Developed a reproducible workflow (Structure-PPi v2.0) to identify mutation clusters at protein-protein interfaces, including web-based visualization.
Built REST API services for the European OpenMinTeD biomedical text-mining platform, wrapping NLP tools as standardized web services.
